decks.notes: This deck aims to utilize cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield early. The combination of Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding helps to control the opponent's plays, while Wrenn and Six provide incremental advantage. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker acts as a win condition, allowing for a game-winning combo with the enchantment. The deck also includes a suite of versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Fire / Ice, and Spell Pierce to control the board and protect the combo pieces.

The deck focuses on using efficient creatures and powerful spells to put pressure on the opponent quickly. By leveraging disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt, as well as versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to control the board while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total. The deck also utilizes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration to maintain consistency and find key pieces. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around being proactive, disrupting the opponent's game plan, and closing out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck revolves around quickly filling the graveyard with cards using self-mill effects like Darkblast and Stinkweed Imp. This allows the player to bring back powerful creatures like Narcomoeba, Ox of Agonas, and Prized Amalgam to the battlefield for free. Creeping Chill provides additional value while Cathartic Reunion and Otherworldly Gaze help dig for combo pieces. Silversmote Ghoul and Merchant of the Vale offer additional graveyard recursion options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats from the graveyard while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to enable explosive ramp and combo potential with Primeval Titan. By exploiting Land synergies like Simic Growth Chamber and Gruul Turf, players can generate significant mana advantage and quickly assemble a threatening board presence. The inclusion of utility lands like Vesuva and Castle Garenbrig further enhances the deck's ability to generate value and consistency in executing its game plan. Additionally, the deck incorporates key toolbox cards like Summoner's Pact and Tolaria West to efficiently search for necessary combo pieces and answer potential threats.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. It utilizes creatures with abilities to generate value and pressure the opponent, while also making use of powerful spells like Thoughtseize and Blood Moon to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The goal is to apply pressure early and often, while controlling the game with removal spells and hand disruption to keep the opponent on the back foot. The mana base is streamlined to support the aggressive game plan and allow for consistency in casting spells.

The key concept of this deck is to maintain control over the game while putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By using countermagic, efficient removal spells, and versatile threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure on multiple fronts. The inclusion of cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble helps the deck maintain card advantage and gain information about the opponent's hand, allowing for strategic decision-making throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using creatures that have value when they enter or leave the battlefield, alongside powerful creatures that can be tutored for using various spells. By utilizing efficient mana dorks and mana fixing lands, the deck aims to ramp quickly into its combo pieces or disruptive elements such as Thoughtseize. With the ability to tutor for specific creatures using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can adapt to various situations and assemble game-winning combos with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while putting pressure on the board with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, while utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Hidetsugu Consumes All for additional reach and finisher potential. The deck's mana base is streamlined to support its aggressive game plan, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of its spells.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying a swarm of Goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent and deal damage. Utilizing cards like Conspicuous Snoop and Goblin Matron to search for key combo pieces like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Sling-Gang Lieutenant, the deck aims to create powerful board states and close out games with aggressive attacks. Aether Vial helps accelerate the deployment of Goblins, while cards like Munitions Expert provide removal options to clear the path for attacks. The deck's mana base is optimized to support its aggressive game plan and maximize its consistency.

This deck aims to aggressively control the board by using efficient creatures and removal spells to quickly build up a threatening board presence. By utilizing a mix of powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial, this deck looks to pressure the opponent early and keep them on the back foot throughout the game. With a strong mana base to support its multicolor spells, this deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive strategy while maintaining the ability to disrupt any potential threats.

The deck focuses on playing efficient and aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent early on, supported by disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to control the board. The key strategy is to maintain tempo and pressure through cheap spells while utilizing card selection from cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to ensure consistency. The mana base is optimized for a smooth curve and access to both red and blue sources, allowing for flexibility in casting spells and adapting to different board states.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the card Glimpse of Tomorrow to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield and create big board presence quickly. By using cards like Risen Reef and Wavesifter to generate value from the creatures entering the battlefield, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board state. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Violent Outburst helps to control the board and protect against opposing threats, while the land base allows for efficient mana fixing and ramping. Overall, the deck focuses on explosive plays and combo potential.

This deck focuses on quickly disrupting and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Using cards like Fury, Grief, Thoughtseize, and Terminate, the deck aims to control the opponent's board while dealing direct damage. The inclusion of Feign Death and Undying Evil adds a surprise factor to the deck, allowing for unexpected plays. The deck also utilizes cards like Blood Moon and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, disruptive, and efficient in dealing damage.

This deck aims to quickly cycle through its creatures and spells to fill the graveyard and cast Living End, which will return all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield, while clearing the opponent's board. The deck also utilizes cards like Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By controlling the board with tempo plays and overwhelming creatures, the deck can quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to recover, making it a powerful and resilient combo deck in Modern.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing powerful threats early on to pressure the opponent and control the game through counter spells and removal. It includes cards that generate card advantage like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble, alongside efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Brazen Borrower and Archmage's Charm to maintain board control. Overall, the strategy is to curve out with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while keeping the opponent on the back foot with counterspells and removal.

The key concept of this deck is to deploy aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler early on, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. By combining efficient threats with disruptive spells, this UR Aggro deck aims to apply early pressure and control the battlefield to secure a quick victory in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.
